title: GCLI-11 follow-up: barrel namespace importers, import {} as a module edge, export = namespace as unresolved (DEC-216 (a6))
description:
Files opum-doc ruling DEC-216 (a6), 2026-11-17, as one task, tracker-only; NOT started. GCLI-36 (12a) comes first. It settles the three questions GCLI-11's review left to opum-doc, plus the GCLI-35 item (i) divergence. Ruling VERBATIM (the GCLI-12 Q1 and Q2 lines are carried by GCLI-36 and GCLI-37):
"- (a5) gap (2), a namespace importer of a BARREL: A. A namespace or side-effect importer of any module that re-exports the reached exported symbol (named re-export or `export *`, followed transitively through re-export chains) is a terminal at depth k+1, each importer once at its shortest depth. Test: `import * as b from "./barrel"` over `export * from "./m"` is reached from m's exported `a`.
- (a5) gap (6), `import {} from "./m"`: A. It is a side-effect module edge.
- GCLI-35, `export = N` with a TS namespace: A. It counts as an unresolved import, reading item 4 strictly. Drop the module edge and name it in ADR 0004."
Where the code is: src/impact.ts (the module-edge trigger keys on the declaring file, byModule.get(current.symbol.file)); src/indexer.ts recordImport (an import with an empty named list writes nothing) and recordImportEquals (the ValueModule disjunct). ADR 0004 Consequences currently name the barrel gap and the import {} case as routed to opum-doc and must be updated.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A namespace or side-effect importer of any module that re-exports the reached exported symbol (named re-export or export *, followed transitively through re-export chains) is a terminal at depth k+1, each importer once at its shortest depth; a test shows import * as b from ./barrel over export * from ./m is reached from the exported a of m, and a transitive two-barrel chain is reached too.
import {} from ./m is recorded as a side-effect module edge, with a test.

export = N, where N is a TypeScript namespace, counts as an unresolved import (the ValueModule disjunct is dropped; a whole-module alias is still a module edge through a SourceFile declaration), with a test, and ADR 0004 names it.
ADR 0004 Consequences drop the two routed-to-opum-doc gaps and state the rulings; each of the three changes has a mutation that reddens exactly its own test; bun run check passes.
